description: Base wallet profile: One-call profile of a Base address: ETH and USDC balances, nonce, contract or not (bytecode size), and its most recent USDC transfers in and out over the last ~50,000 blocks. First-seen date is not available without an indexer and is reported as such. Sources: Base public RPCs. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: eth, usdc, nonce, is_contract, bytecode_bytes, usdc_transfers{items[{direction, from, to, amount, tx}]}, limits[].

limit.description: most recent USDC transfers to return, 1-25 (default 10)

name: x420_chain_wallet-profile
